ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: It is known that the length of segment $AB=20$. $M$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$, and $P$ is any point on segment $AB$. $N$ is the midpoint of segment $PB$. When $P$ is the midpoint of segment $AM$, what is the length of segment $NB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: As shown in the figure, since $M$ is the midpoint of the segment $AB$, $AB=20$\\
therefore $MA=\frac{1}{2}AB=10$\\
since $P$ is the midpoint of the segment $AM$,\\
therefore $AP=\frac{1}{2}AM=5$\\
therefore $PB=AB-AP=20-5=15$\\
since $N$ is the midpoint of the segment $PB$\\
therefore $NB=\frac{1}{2}PB=\boxed{7.5}$
